parameters.label: Gross loop water demand
parameters.contextMeaning: BVAD potable content is one stream, not gross circulating demand.
parameters.requiredEvidence: Define potable, hygiene, food, EVA and other streams and their recovery boundaries.

parameters.label: Loop water recovery
parameters.requiredEvidence: Demonstrate architecture-specific stream recovery, losses and degradation.

parameters.label: Initial water inventory
parameters.requiredEvidence: Size startup inventory with a commissioning and water-loop balance.

parameters.label: Makeup-water reserve
parameters.requiredEvidence: Define reserve policy and credible outage/replenishment cases.

parameters.label: Fraction of makeup supplied by ISRU
parameters.requiredEvidence: Define the imported/produced water allocation and startup schedule.

parameters.label: Extractable fraction of ice
parameters.requiredEvidence: Measure accessible local ice fraction, depth, distribution and excavation losses.

parameters.label: Water capture / purification recovery
parameters.contextMeaning: Study extraction efficiency does not establish combined capture/purification recovery.
parameters.requiredEvidence: Separate extraction, capture and purification yields using an applicable process.

parameters.label: Regolith throughput per unit
parameters.requiredEvidence: Validate excavation/feed throughput against material and operating conditions.

parameters.label: Electrical capacity per unit
parameters.contextMeaning: The published power is an architecture-level requirement, not per-unit capacity.
parameters.requiredEvidence: Size electrical and thermal loads, auxiliaries, startup and peak demand.

parameters.label: Process energy per regolith mass
parameters.requiredEvidence: Validate full regolith process energy with temperature and heat recovery.

parameters.label: Additional process energy per water mass
parameters.requiredEvidence: Validate additional capture/purification energy without double counting.

parameters.label: Operating duty over 730 days
parameters.contextMeaning: A 225-day production assumption does not establish a two-year duty cycle.
parameters.requiredEvidence: Validate a 730-day operating/maintenance and energy-availability schedule.

parameters.label: Installed extraction unit mass
parameters.contextMeaning: The published mass is a complete propellant architecture, not a water extraction unit.
parameters.requiredEvidence: Provide an installed equipment bill of materials and declared margins.

parameters.label: Shared ISRU balance of plant
parameters.requiredEvidence: Inventory shared plant, deployment, controls and thermal equipment.

parameters.label: Power generation specific mass
parameters.requiredEvidence: Select a generator and include distribution, conversion and deployment.

parameters.label: Independent storage autonomy
parameters.requiredEvidence: Size autonomy against a declared load and accepted outage schedule.

parameters.label: Usable storage efficiency
parameters.contextMeaning: Maximum discharge is distinct from conversion efficiency and degradation.
parameters.requiredEvidence: Separate usable depth of discharge, conversion losses and degradation.

parameters.label: Storage specific mass
parameters.contextMeaning: Study battery energy density does not specify the complete installed storage boundary.
parameters.requiredEvidence: Validate installed storage mass per nameplate energy, thermal control and margins.

parameters.label: Life-support hardware
parameters.requiredEvidence: Provide an architecture-matched life-support equipment inventory.

parameters.label: Dry-system spares fraction
parameters.requiredEvidence: Define reliability, maintenance, replacement inventory and allocation basis.

references.title: NASA Life Support Baseline Values and Assumptions, Rev. 2 (2022)
references.scope: Reference human metabolic interfaces; the potable stream is not the complete habitat water loop.

references.title: NASA lunar water ISRU propellant system study (2021)
references.scope: Propellant architecture, including excavation, transport and cryogenic processing. Published mass excludes power supply/transmission and system thermal management. Its operating timeline needs further site analysis.

observations.label: Assumed production time
observations.location: Ground rules; timeline caveat on PDF p. 7

referenceConversions.meaning: Reciprocal of the study assumption, 140 Wh/kg. Installed system boundary is unconfirmed; not applied to storage sizing.

gates.meaning: Two pinned NASA PDFs; seven published values checked against their pages. Applicability is separate.
Map all water streams, installed equipment, energy and accounting exclusions to one architecture.
Demonstrate startup, outages, degradation, maintenance and two-year power/storage scheduling.
Load applicable extractable ice/yield evidence, or explicitly accept a hypothetical study.
Record an independent engineering review and accepted reference cases before enabling logistics verdicts.

terrainReference.beyondExtentExclusion: Conditional on declared 20 km ceiling; not independent physical certification

acceptance.reason: Published local correlated ensembles, wider nominal horizons, partial quality-filtered stereo comparisons and NASA architecture bookkeeping are implemented. Independent absolute terrain truth, full global/orientation covariance, physical hardware/process/operations calibration and selected-site extractable ice remain unavailable.
